The game is set in a dystopia in 2030 and follows Kara Hassan, who must compete in a deadly tournament known as the "Rollerdrome", in which she must fight enemies in an arena using firearms while roller skating. The game mixes roller skating with third-person shooting, requiring players to perform acrobatics to reload firearms. As players progress, they unlock more weapons and fight more-challenging opponents.

The game was originally conceived as a licensed tie-in game endorsed by heavy metal musician Ozzy Osbourne, but licensing difficulties and the impact of the September 11 attacks on the entertainment industry forced iRock to retool the game and release it without the Osbourne branding.
